lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular clusters arranged in three primary horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region. The central row exhibits roughly equidistant spacing between major spot centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a subtle grid-like appearance across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible running from the posterior gill area toward the caudal peduncle, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high reflectance above to shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 10-12 distinct high-luminance blobs, with a higher spatial density observed along the anterior margin compared to the central surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. A white linear mark, indicative of a scar or abrasion, is visible on the leading edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region displays a high-density cluster of micro-spots that are significantly smaller than the macro-spots present on the lateral trunk.
